name: Chain (sequential)
tagline: Linear pipeline 0 -> 1 -> 2 -> ... -> N-1: each agent revises the predecessor's solution. Maximum depth, zero parallelism.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize edges = [].
2. For i in 0..N-2:
3.    edges.append((i, i+1)).
4. Return edges.
// Depth $O(N)$, edges $O(N)$. Deep iterative refinement; no diversity branch.
diff_from_baseline: MacNet-style chain topology (Qian et al., 'Scaling Large-Language-Model-based Multi-Agent Collaboration', 2024). Sequential refinement reference design; the rigorous-codebase default.

name: Layered (MLP-like)
tagline: Splits N agents into $L=\max(2,\log_2 N)$ layers, fully connecting adjacent layers; balances depth (refinement) with width (parallel diversity).
pseudocode:
1. layer_num = max(2, $\lfloor\log_2 N\rfloor$); layers = [N // layer_num] * layer_num; layers[0] += N % layer_num.
2. Compute start/end ids for each layer.
3. For l in 0..len(layers)-2:
4.    For each u in layer l, for each v in layer l+1: edges.append((u, v)).
5. Return edges.
diff_from_baseline: MacNet-style layered/MLP topology (Qian et al. 2024). Reference design that interpolates between chain and star by stacking width.

name: Star (hub-and-spoke)
tagline: Single source agent broadcasts to all others; each spoke independently produces a candidate answer. Depth O(1), maximum parallelism.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize edges = [].
2. For i in 1..N-1:
3.    edges.append((0, i)).
4. Return edges.
// Depth $O(1)$, edges $O(N)$. Pure exploration; no iterative refinement chain.
diff_from_baseline: MacNet-style star topology (Qian et al. 2024). Reference design emphasizing parallel diverse generation over iterative refinement.
